_comment: The conversion batch. `converted` are the specifications that have a config in this directory and a committed document; `ready` are the ones whose shape the pipeline already handles, so onboarding them is a config file plus the editorial work named in `needs`. Run them with tools/build_all.py.

ready.shape: companion specification with an information model
ready.needs: conformance-unit identifier tokens (DCH-*) assigned per node in its build_model.py; its clause 10 already separates the units in prose

ready.shape: declared partial compliance, as WoT Binding
ready.needs: the no-information-model deviation declared in its config; it defines a DataEncoding, not an address space, so it has no NodeSet

ready.shape: declared partial compliance, as WoT Binding
ready.needs: the no-information-model deviation declared in its config; at 322 KB it is the largest draft in the repository
a conformance clause, which the addendum does not have; its model declares instances rather than types, so it fills the Instances clause and no type clause

notAFit.why: an amendment to OPC 10000-3, not a companion specification. OPC 20020 is the companion-specification template; rendering a core-part amendment into it would misrepresent what the document is. The same content is carried by OPC-UA-Data-Channels.md, which is a companion specification and is listed as ready.
an amendment to OPC 10000-4; see above.
an amendment to OPC 10000-6; see above.
a measurement report, not a specification.
